is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles coluzzii, Anopheles melas, and Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea (p. 4, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Molecular testing was performed solely for species identification within the Anopheles gambiae complex using diagnostic PCR and HhaI digestion (p. 3). No target insecticide resistance markers (e.g., Vgsc L995F/S, Ace-1 G280S) were genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No resistance marker genotype counts, allele frequencies, or sample sizes for resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquito collections were conducted using human landing catches in four villages (Mongola, Arena Blanca, Biabia, Balboa) on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea between 2009 and 2014 (p. 2-3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study analyzing mosquito collection rates, species composition, and indoor/outdoor host-seeking proportions over six years (p. 1-3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Field sites are specified at village level with geographic coordinates: Mongola (3°45'N, 8°43'E), Biabia (3°45'N, 8°42'E), Arena Blanca (3°30'N, 8°34'E), and Balboa (3°23'N, 8°46'E) (p. 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were carried out regularly from 2009 to 2014, and data are reported annually (p. 3, Fig. 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Collections were conducted as part of the Bioko Island Malaria Control Project (BIMCP) vector monitoring program, but present primary collection and species identification data from 2009 to 2014.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary file 1 contains IRS spray round schedules; no resistance marker genotyping data is mentioned or missing.

assessment.summary: This study monitored Anopheles gambiae s.l. vector density, species composition (An. coluzzii, An. melas, An. gambiae s.s.), and indoor vs. outdoor host-seeking behavior across four villages on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea, between 2009 and 2014. Although molecular PCR was used for species identification, no insecticide resistance target site markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report extractable resistance marker genotype data.
